[[Jonoss Nodahlon]] can found patrolling the easternmost section of the [[Citadel of Dzagon]] in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Sometimes, when it's really late at night and I've been on duty for hours and hours, I entertain myself by pretending I'm a courier in the distant future, with flying metal ships and lightning-boxes that can send messages all over the world...instantly!" ''

==Quotes==
:''"My future's so bright, I have to stand in the shade."''
:''"This time, you're the courier and I get to be the exiled diplomat. Did you bring the bone dice so we can decide if the message gets through in time to save the world?"''

==Notes==
*His dialogue appears to be describing airplanes and computers.
